description: Angular component for configuring notification templates, including form controls, validation, and TinyMCE editor setup.

classes.name: NotificationTemplateConfigurationComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing notification template configuration, including form handling, validation, and TinyMCE editor setup.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the form values based on provided partial delivery template settings.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate form value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the control is touched (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on the input boolean.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form and returns validation errors if invalid.

methods.name: get notificationTapActionHint
methods.description: Returns a localized hint string based on the notification type.

methods.name: expandedForm
methods.description: Checks if a delivery method's form block is expanded.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Calls the registered change callback with the current form value.

methods.name: updateExpandedForm
methods.description: Updates the list of expanded form blocks based on validation state.

methods.name: updateDisabledForms
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on the 'enabled' field.

methods.name: buildForm
methods.description: Constructs the main form group with controls for each notification delivery method.

methods.name: buildDeliveryMethodControl
methods.description: Creates a form group for a specific notification delivery method with validation and controls.
